visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with long brown hair, wearing a pink floral qipao and festive gold earrings, is centered in a medium close-up shot. She smiles directly at the camera, frequently gesturing with her hands held together in a traditional greeting pose. The background is a detailed studio set resembling a traditional Chinese home, featuring red lattice windows, lit red lanterns, and festive wall decorations. Animated red waves and gold ingots line the bottom of the frame. (2) The scene transitions to a full-screen graphic background in vibrant red with swirling cloud motifs. A 3D-styled animated gold snake character wearing a small red vest appears on the right, holding a red lantern. Large stylized Chinese calligraphy and English New Year text are positioned centrally in the frame.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a festive greeting for the fifth day of the Lunar New Year. The speaker, Teacher Yu Yang, explains the traditional custom of 'Po Wu' (breaking taboos) and encourages viewers to pray for prosperity and share the video to spread good fortune, effectively promoting her personal brand and platform.
